instruction.name: movfrh2gr.s
instruction.description: Extract the high 32 bits of fj into rd.

experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 6666 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 9 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 8' --asm 'movfrh2gr.s $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5; st.d $r4, $r12, 0; fld.d $f0, $r12, 0'

experiments.name: closure calibration with movfr2gr.s
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 6666 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 9 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 8' --asm 'movfr2gr.s $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5; st.d $r4, $r12, 0; fld.d $f0, $r12, 0'
experiments.notes: Same chain with movfr2gr.s (3 cycles) in place of movfrh2gr.s, so the store/fld.d closure is 10.37 cycles.

latencies.notes: fj -> rd. The chain closes through st.d/fld.d; its 10.37-cycle cost is calibrated by replacing the move with movfr2gr.s (3 cycles). Raw spread 13.09-13.19 cycles. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0. Raw value was 2.75 cycles; the recorded nominal value is the nearest whole cycle, matching the repository convention.
